title: Data Center Power Demand
_authoring: Authored 2026-06-19, factual content; no fabricated DOIs. Deeper quantitative figures flagged needs-authoring.

activations.domainDescription: Training runs are large, schedulable, and bursty; inference is smaller but continuous and latency-sensitive — they shape the load curve differently.
activations.domainFunction: Determines how flexible the load is: training can shift in time/place, inference largely cannot.

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.functional_reason: GPUs set the per-job power profile for both training and inference.

activations.domainDescription: Per-rack power has risen from ~5-10 kW to 50-100+ kW with AI accelerators, forcing liquid cooling and new power distribution.
activations.domainFunction: Drives cooling method and electrical design; high density is the proximate cause of the cooling shift.

companies.name: Vertiv
companies.functional_reason: Power and cooling systems engineered for high-density racks.

activations.domainDescription: Utilities receive speculative, duplicated interconnection requests; separating real from phantom demand is critical to avoid over- or under-building.
activations.domainFunction: Prevents both stranded generation and shortfalls by cleaning the demand signal.
